rationale: One directly shared canonical INSERT to risk_holds is replaced by fixed authenticated QA owner. Owner independently checks most recent persisted risk assessment for the exact domain, subject and scope, insists on hold/block action and exact reason-code, and prevents replay from reopening a released hold using stale assessment. Checkout/payout amounts are re-derived from primary records, not caller input. SQL insert repeats latest-assessment and no-active-hold guards. Existing risk case workflows remain unchanged. Other four risk-tax SQL mutations retain exact literals/functions and re-attested source fingerprints. Production legal authority remains disabled. Private owner validates newest immutable assessment, recomputes action and level from current policy thresholds, and vetoes risk reductions conflicting with active holds. Production legal owner and release stay disabled. The only subsequent source change formats the static import; both surviving protected source SQL sites have updated exact source fingerprints.
